messages.content: Return JSON containing only smoke: a concise POSIX shell test source string. The adapter is independently passing and MUST NOT be changed. Its interface is one UTF-8 COMMAND-LINE ARGUMENT, not stdin, and stdout must be exactly that argument followed by one LF. The old smoke and its actual failed process observation are included. Repair only that test. Invoke /bin/sh /workspace/extension/adapter.sh with one argument. One small case suffices, but compare exact bytes including the final LF; shell command substitution strips trailing newlines and is not an exact-byte comparison. Temporary test files under /tmp are permitted. The test must return zero for the correct adapter and nonzero for both a no-output adapter and an adapter missing its final LF. No network, secrets, host access or persistent changes; no explanations or manifest. Independent tests remain unchanged and outside your control.

{"contract":"Transport one given UTF-8 payload unchanged with exactly one appended LF; do not evaluate it or decide its meaning.","diagnostics": ["partial-revision-context",  ["replace",  [ ["candidate-file", "candidate_tests/smoke.sh", "#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Correct adapter: echoes argument + LF
out=$(printf 'héllo\nworld' | /bin/sh /workspace/extension/adapter.sh)
exp=$(printf 'héllo\nworld\n')
[ "$out" = "$exp" ] || exit 1

# No-output adapter: must fail
printf '' > /tmp/noout.sh
chmod +x /tmp/noout.sh
if /bin/sh /tmp/noout.sh 'héllo\nworld' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 1
fi

# Missing final LF adapter: must fail
printf '%s' 'héllo\nworld' > /tmp/nolf.sh
chmod +x /tmp/nolf.sh
if /bin/sh /tmp/nolf.sh 'héllo\nworld' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 1
fi
